description: This file defines a benchmark test class using Android's Macrobenchmark framework to measure app startup performance and scroll frame timing, specifically for the 'ai.openclaw.app' package.

classes.name: StartupMacrobenchmark
classes.description: JUnit test class for benchmarking app startup and scroll performance in the 'ai.openclaw.app' package.

methods.name: coldStartup
methods.description: Runs a benchmark to measure cold startup time with 10 iterations.

methods.name: startupAndScrollFrameTiming
methods.description: Runs a benchmark to measure warm startup and scrolling performance with frame timing metrics.

methods.name: runBenchmarkOrSkip
methods.description: Helper method that executes a benchmark run, skipping if known device issues are detected.
